params.body:
## What

`/pricing` reads the plans from the Observatory (`Plan`, projected through `Offer`). Three other places had the prices written by hand, so a price changed on the Observatory reached `/pricing` and nothing else:

- **The homepage teaser:** all four names, prices and lines.
- **`/services`:** the name and price of Signal, Decode and Intelligence.
- **The line under a post**, "from EUR 14.99 a month".

All three now read `Plan` for name and price. The teaser also takes its one-line description from the plan. `/services` keeps its own longer copy per tier, because that is content, not a price.

Not touched: `resources/legal/terms-en.md` names the prices too. A change to legal text is a decision, not a cleanup. The terms also describe Decode as "up to four named users", while the pricing page says every plan is personal and in your own name. That is worth a look with Maarten.

## Tests

All 318 pass (PHPUnit directly), and Pint and the Tailwind check pass. `PricesFromOneSourceTest` stores different prices in the projection and expects them on `/` and `/services`. It fails on the old views.
params.title: A price lives in one place
